text:
alex: Quick heads-up — scheduling a maintenance window to pin runtime to model-1.4 for a rolling fix. Target window: 2026-04-02 00:30-01:30 UTC. Please review comms snippets below and confirm.

maria: ack. Are we doing a full traffic cut or can we do staged pinning per zone? :thinking_face:

sam: staging per region. Start with us-east-1 canary, wait 10m, then us-west-2, then eu-west-1. If any error rate > 2% in 5m -> hold and roll back.

julian: Deployment steps for the runbook:
1) `/deploy pin runtime:model-1.4 --zones us-east-1 --canary 5%` 
2) monitor `svc/errors` and p99 latency for 10m
3) /deploy pin --continue -> remaining zones

sre-oncall: adding monitoring checks now. Will post dashboards and alert thresholds.

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance created by alex for 2026-04-02 00:30 UTC. ID: mnt-2468. Use `/deploy status mnt-2468` to view progress. :robot_face:

support-liz: Draft statuspage snippet below — please edit.

support-liz: ```
Component: Redwood Inference API (text generation)
Start: 2026-04-02 00:30 UTC
ETA: ~1 hour
Impact: brief degraded latency for a subset of requests during model pinning. No data loss expected.
Updates: posted every 15 minutes; customers can subscribe.
``` 

alex: LGTM but tweak "brief degraded latency" -> "possible short spikes in latency". Also add link to incident contact for enterprise customers.

support-liz: updated snippet.

support-liz: Email template (short):

"We're performing scheduled maintenance to pin the runtime to model-1.4 to mitigate recent inference regressions. Window: 2026-04-02 00:30-01:30 UTC. You may see short spikes in latency or increased tail latency during the window. We'll provide updates on the status page and reach out directly if you have reserved Dedicated instances."

maria: For Dedicated customers we should include: "No changes to customer-managed infra. Contact your account SE for booking a private window." Add that to email.

sam: Rollback criteria (official):
- Error rate baseline +2% sustained for 5m
- P95 latency increase > 250ms for 10m
- Any verified customer-impacting errors reported by Support (ticket >= P2)
If any trigger -> issue ` /deploy rollback mnt-2468` and pin back to model-1.3.

julian: Add an operational note for runbook: keep `kv-cache` warmers running during the canary to reduce cold-start noise.

sre-oncall: Dashboards posted: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/maintenance-mnt-2468
Alerts: `MAINT_MNT_2468_ERROR_RATE` and `MAINT_MNT_2468_LATENCY` set. I'll mute non-critical noise channels during the window.

alex: final ask — can marketing hold off announcement until we've validated canary for 20m? I don't want an external comms until we confirm no regressions.

support-liz: noted. I'll queue the status page updates but set initial visibility to internal-only until we get the green.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled for 2026-04-02 00:00 UTC: "preflight checks: release artifacts verified, rollback plan in place, oncall assigned." 

alex: thanks everyone. I'll be on the call. Ping @sre-oncall if anything anomalous comes up. :thumbsup:
